ShareCursor 0.6.1 installers — Windows input and file clipboard fixes

Tested source commit: 9109bb12e5c861f1034d5491f2cf78fa163e9705
Main merge commit: 0f7d54f
Pull request: https://github.com/alimomin-12/ShareCursor/pull/2
Build: https://github.com/alimomin-12/ShareCursor/actions/runs/37188025123
CI: https://github.com/alimomin-12/ShareCursor/actions/runs/37188025127

Windows: ShareCursor-Setup-0.6.1.exe
macOS (Apple Silicon + Intel): ShareCursor-0.6.1.dmg
Checksums: ShareCursor-SHA256SUMS.txt

Install this version on BOTH computers: protocol 6 rejects older input peers.
Existing settings and the first-launch config/menu-bar fixes are retained.
Copy regular files in Explorer/Finder; wait for transfer completion, then paste.
Received files are also saved in Downloads/ShareCursor. Zip folders first.
Folder clipboard copying and dragging files across screens are not supported.

Verification: formatting, clippy and native tests passed on Windows, macOS and Linux. Full tray/GUI tests passed on Windows (43 tests) and macOS (40 tests), including native file clipboard write/read. Encrypted transfer tests verified exact bytes, duplicate-name preservation and interrupted-file cleanup. Injected Windows events bypass capture; physical events remain consumable. An 8,000-event motion burst became 16 bounded packets with no distance loss.

Encrypted loopback transport benchmark (5,000 round trips):
Windows median RTT 47.40 us, p99 76.60 us.
macOS median RTT 33.54 us, p99 99.96 us.
These measure transport overhead, not physical mouse or LAN latency.

Installer builds and downloaded SHA-256 checksums were verified. Physical two-machine hand-off, manual installation and Explorer/Finder paste have not been tested in this environment. These installers are unsigned and have not been published as a tagged GitHub release.
